items.title: 🏅 Holy Deliverance Receives the PEACMark
items.description: 🎉 We are proud to announce that Holy Deliverance Integrated Christian School of Angono, Rizal Inc. has been successfully recertified by the Private Education Assistance Committee (PEAC) for our Junior High School, with our certification remaining valid until 2029! 🙏

items.title: 🙌 JHS & SHS Fellowship | Together in Worship
items.description: Our JHS and SHS students finally came together in one place to worship and praise God. It was a meaningful time of singing, prayer, sharing God’s Word, and fellowship as one school community.

items.title: DEPED Monitoring Inspection: 100% Readiness Rating! 🙏
items.description: We are grateful to announce that our school received a 100% Percentage Readiness rating, interpreted as “Highly Ready,” during the DepEd Monitoring Inspection for the Opening of Classes.

items.title: 🏆 APPSAA Update | Congratulations, Batang Holy! 🏆
items.description: Congratulations to our Batang Holy athletes for their outstanding performances and victories in the ongoing Angono Public & Private Schools Athletic Association (APPSAA) games!
